name: cyberdns-tip
description: CyberDNS TIP — Threat Intelligence & Domain Blocklist management platform (React + Express + PostgreSQL).

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-maplibre-worker.mjs && vite build && esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/server.cjs && esbuild scripts/migrate.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --sourcemap --outfile=dist/migrate.cjs && esbuild scripts/baseline-existing-db.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/baseline.cjs

_overridesNote: express 4.x pins qs 6.15.3 (last version in the qs DoS / array-limit advisory range); the override forces the patched line everywhere. Remove once express depends on qs >= 6.16.
